events.text: Louis XIV of France dies after a 72-year reign, the longest of any major European monarch.
Astronomer Richard Carrington observes a huge solar flare, the start of the Carrington Event.
Emma Nutt becomes the world's first female telephone operator, in Boston.
Martha, the last known passenger pigeon, dies at the Cincinnati Zoo.
The Great Kantō earthquake devastates Tokyo and Yokohama.
Germany invades Poland, beginning the Second World War in Europe.
Muammar Gaddafi seizes power in Libya in a military coup.
Bobby Fischer beats Boris Spassky in Reykjavík to become world chess champion.
Korean Air Lines Flight 007 is shot down by a Soviet interceptor.
The wreck of the Titanic is located by a Franco-American expedition.
